title: Vũ Điệu Rừng Xanh — Indoor Living and Community Blog

motion.name: landing-perspective-bloom
motion.value: 18s linear infinite radial perspective keyframe + scroll --hero-travel and pointer --hero-mx/--hero-my
motion.purpose: 18 tiles emerge softly blurred and faint from the center vanishing point behind h1, accelerating and scaling outward along perspective rays. Reduced motion parks outer tiles in a static halo.

motion.name: landing-state
motion.purpose: Local control, adaptive navbar, manifesto illumination, and disclosure feedback; reduced motion disables transitions.

motion.name: blog-article-loop
motion.purpose: Existing article strip moves at 22px per second; pause on hover, stop for keyboard focus, and disable for reduced motion.

display.purpose: Be Vietnam Pro carries centered landing display type and editorial section headings; Blog retains its independent scale.

components.name: Landing Primary Button
components.description: Floema 12px-radius deep forest action button with flour-yellow ink.
components.html: <button class="ds-room-button" type="button">Gợi ý cây cho tôi</button>
components.css: .ds-room-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--fl-forest, #042d2b); color: var(--fl-yellow, #e9e778); font: 600 0.9rem 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s ease; } .ds-room-button:hover { background: #241f21; } .ds-room-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #042d2b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Blog Primary Button
components.description: Community search and publishing use pill buttons with 44px minimum targets.
components.css: .ds-blog-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #34533c; color: #fff; font: 600 13px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-blog-button:hover { background: #243b30; } .ds-blog-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #34533c; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Blog Search Field
components.description: A persistent label and native search field with 16px input text.
components.html: <label class="ds-blog-field">Tìm bài viết<input class="ds-blog-search" type="search" placeholder="Tiêu đề, nội dung hoặc chủ đề"></label>
components.css: .ds-blog-field { display: grid; gap: 9px; color: #52604f; font: 400 12px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; } .ds-blog-search { min-width: 0; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid #bdc9b6; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #000; caret-color: #34533c; font: 400 16px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; } .ds-blog-search::placeholder { color: #596251; opacity: 1; } .ds-blog-search:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #34533c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Blog View Navigation
components.description: Personal views use underlined links; the active view remains identifiable without color.
components.html: Tất cảBài của tôiĐã lưu
components.css: .ds-blog-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dce3dc; font: 400 13px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; } .ds-blog-tabs a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: #52604f; text-decoration: none; } .ds-blog-tabs a[aria-current] { border-bottom-color: #34533c; color: #243b30; font-weight: 600; } .ds-blog-tabs a:hover { color: #243b30; } .ds-blog-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #34533c; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Blog Topic Label
components.description: A passive pale-green topic label inside each community post.
components.css: .ds-blog-topic { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 5px; background: #edf2ed; color: #34533c; font: 500 11px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; }

components.name: Room Plant Note
components.description: Numbered room annotations open 12px-radius desktop notes; mobile notes expand below the photograph in document flow.
components.html:
Bàng Singapore

Lá to, dáng cao. Một điểm nhấn tự nhiên cho góc phòng nhiều ánh sáng.

Tìm hiểu cây này
components.css: .ds-plant-note { width: min(296px, 42vw); padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #241f21; border: 1px solid rgba(36, 31, 33, .14); box-shadow: 0 20px 44px rgba(36, 31, 33, .2); } .ds-plant-note h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 600 1.05rem/1.35 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; } .ds-plant-note p { margin: 0 0 10px; color: #524945; font: 400 0.87rem/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; } .ds-plant-note a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #042d2b; font: 600 0.86rem 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(4, 45, 43, .32); } .ds-plant-note a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #042d2b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Community Vote Controls
components.description: Up/down arrows retain the existing separate like/dislike counts and pressed states.
components.css: .ds-votes { display: inline-flex; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 999px; background: #f0f3ef; } .ds-votes button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; background: #f0f3ef; color: #40503f; font: 700 12px "Be Vietnam Pro", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-votes svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-downvote svg { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-votes button:hover { background: #e3eadf; color: #243b30; } .ds-votes button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-votes button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #dfebda; color: #34533c; } .ds-votes .ds-downvote[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #f2e9e2; color: #8a5c40; }

narrative.northStar: An airy Floema-inspired botanical invitation to indoor living
narrative.overview: Warm ivory (#f2efea), deep forest green (#042d2b), flour yellow (#e9e778) and 12px pill geometry adapt Floema's architectural rhythm to Vietnamese plant discovery. A 1-point perspective minimalist hero leads to an annotated living room, scroll-lit manifesto with curated blog cards, a 2x2 live plant finder, dappled leaf-shadow categories, forest narrative band, staggered care pillars and a line-art yellow footer. The Community Blog retains its independent design and behavior.
dos: Preserve non-commercial plant guidance, live catalog counts and category pills.
Keep catalog, advisor, blog, account and favorite links functional.
Preserve native scrolling, adaptive navbar contrast and reduced-motion fallbacks.
Scope all Floema landing overrides inside .landing-page.
donts: Do not add sales claims, testimonials, stock metrics or eyebrow headings.
Do not extend landing styles to internal, blog or admin pages.
Do not let radial hero tiles cover the central headline or break keyboard access.
